div.head: Grið 12
div.ab: 7 gyf man beforan æðelinge oððe arcebiscpe gefeoht agynneð, mid CL scillinga gebete; gyf beforan oðran biscpe oððe ealdormen þis gelimpe, mid C scill' gebete.
And gyf man beforan æðelinge oððe arcebiscpe gefeoht agynneð, mid CL scillinga gebete; gyf beforan oðran biscpe oððe ealdormen þis gelimpe, mid C scillingum gebete.

And if anyone starts a fight in the presence of a nobleman or archbishop, he is to compensate with one hundred and fifty shillings; if this occurs in the presence of another bishop or ealdorman, he is to compensate with one hundred shillings.
Und wenn jemand vor einem Prinzen oder Erzbischof Fechten unternimmt, büsse er mit 150 Schilling; wenn dies vor einem anderen Bischof oder einem Ealdorman geschieht, büsse er mit 100 Schill.

And if anyone starts a fight in the presence of a prince or an archbishop, let him atone with 150 shillings; if this happens in the presence of another bishop or an ealdorman, let him atone with 100 shillings.
